parameters.content:
## BOXX - SendGrid Events
Receives SendGrid Event Webhook posts. Unsubscribes, group unsubscribes, spam reports and hard bounces mark the lead STOPPED (unsubscribe_status = TRUE except for bounces).

1. Change the random part of the webhook path, then activate.
2. SendGrid > Settings > Mail Settings > Event Webhook: paste the PRODUCTION URL. Enable Unsubscribes, Group Unsubscribes, Spam Reports, Bounces.
3. Optional: turn on Signed Event Webhook and verify the signature before going wide.

Without this workflow unsubscribe_status is never set and the Scheduler unsubscribe check never fires. Bookings and confirmations still send to unsubscribed leads (transactional).
